}}'''Sarena''' is a powerful Altaran noblewoman. She is stocky, hard-eyed, and has greying hair.  She features a thin scar across her face.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Sarena, Lady}}

==Activities==
[[Nynaeve]] saw her listening to [[Logain]] as he described how the [[Red Ajah]] conspired to establish him as a [[false Dragon]].{{ref/book|6|8}} Lady Sarena questioned [[Lelaine]] in an effort to determine the validity of Logain's claim.  {{ref/book|6|8}}
